title: Linear proof table restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $P$ be a Boolean table indexed by the disjoint union of sets of sizes $2^n$ and $2^{n^2}$. Its restriction to the first summand is a Boolean table on a set of size $2^n$, obtained by evaluating $P$ at the canonical inclusion of each index into that summand.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a Boolean table indexed by a set of size $2^n+2^{n^2}$
